Intel Core i5-12400F Desktop Processor 6 Cores 12 Threads up to 4.40 GHz

Maximize your desktop PC system efficiency and frame processing power with the highly popular Intel Core i5-12400F desktop gaming processor. Available at Turbo Computer, this high-performance PC hardware core component is masterfully engineered for budget-conscious competitive gamers, heavy multi-tasking office users, and entry-tier content creators across Egypt who demand rapid execution tracking, multi-threaded optimization, and incredible value per frame. Built on the revolutionary Alder Lake core architecture design, this processor layout delivers exceptional stability for daily productivity setups.

The Intel Core i5-12400F brings a solid configuration of 6 Performance-cores (P-cores) and 12 processing threads operating at a 2.50 GHz base clock frequency that scales dynamically up to a maximum turbo speed translation of 4.40 GHz. Backed by 18MB of ultra-responsive Intel Smart Cache layout, it minimizes internal latency to boost overall application deployment loops. This flexible hardware platform features comprehensive dual-channel memory tracking layout supporting both standard DDR4 up to 3200MHz and next-generation DDR5 up to 4800MHz frequencies. Running at a highly optimized 65W base power rating, it utilizes advanced PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 connectivity lines directly from the motherboard socket. Please note that this 'F' suffix model architecture requires a discrete discrete graphics card option to display outputs successfully.
